exact_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Enhance only this complete original Silent Storm painted-game diffuse or interface texture. Image1 is exact whole historical RGBA. Image2 is identical entire historical storedRGB enlarged ONLY by nearest-neighbor for original form, scale and phase. Keep complete full canvas, original aspect and retail orientation, all normalized UV/color boundaries, silhouettes and placement exactly. Resolve only fine existing soft game-painted tones at the old feature scale; preserve original local palette, lighting strength and muted highlights. No new objects or details, photographic material, added relief, grain speckles, glow, frames, holes, marks or ornaments. Nearest-neighbor codec blocks are a guide, not new geometric cells. Do not crop, pad, repack, register, rotate, recenter or use bounding boxes. Complete original alpha is authoritative and is restored separately; preserve all full-canvas RGB authoring fields. Pure global numerical brightness follows; no source artwork RGB copying/patching. Return one full texture without labels or comparison. Source48x48 square, production192x192. Exactly ONE existing small painted pistol-like silhouette on ONE muted olive square field with the exact surrounding nearblack margins. Preserve the original retail inverted orientation: broad gray sloping body runs from lowerleft to lowerright, ONE brown grip-like vertical field rises toward upperleft. Preserve only the existing broad outline, muted gray/brown/olive palette and restrained soft highlight along the lower gray edge at the same native positions. Keep all ambiguous tiny gray/black patches as original painted tonal patches; do not decide a firearm model or complete new mechanics. No new trigger loop, screw, sight, muzzle hole, vents, serration rows, cartridges, logos, letters, grip texture or extra hardware. No photographic steel/reflection or fresh white gleam, no sharpened black outline or changed silhouette. Only gentle existing paint-tone resolving; every component count/placement comes from the unchanged complete source, not newly invented tiny parts.

reference_recipe.operations: Exact full source storedRGB NN16x; no crop/padding/registration/unpremultiply/artRGBrepair. Entire rawRGBA LANCZOS source4x; defaultpad/pureglobal scalar and complete originalA restored. Transparent storedRGB premultiplied once; root final typednative audit required.
